name: DrumKick
brief: Synthesized kick drum with pitch envelope and click transient.
description:
Sine oscillator with exponential pitch sweep, optional harmonic
overtones, a short noise click for attack, and tanh soft clipping
for drive.

params.name: pitch_env
params.doc: Frequency sweep range added to base pitch on trigger.

params.name: click
params.doc: Amount of noise burst at the attack transient.

params.name: overtones
params.doc: Harmonic content added to the fundamental.
